chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Jabir ibn Yazid, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

I said to him, 'What is the meaning of Allah, Exalted and Mighty, saying: "So hasten to the remembrance of Allah"?' He said, 'He said: "Work and hasten, for it is a day of constriction for the Muslims in it, and the reward of the deeds of the Muslims in it is according to the degree of constriction upon them, and the good deed and the bad deed are multiplied in it."'

He said, and Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said, 'By Allah, it has reached me that the companions of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) would prepare themselves for Friday on Thursday, because it is a day of constriction for the Muslims.'

key_terms.فَاسْعَوْا إِلَى ذِكِ اللَّهِ: So hasten to the remembrance of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of hastening to worship on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) interprets the command to 'hasten' in Surah Al-Jumu'ah as an urgent preparation for Friday, noting that the day brings spiritual 'constriction' (mudayyaq) where deeds are multiplied according to the difficulty faced. This tradition underscores the Shia emphasis on proactive spiritual readiness, exemplified by the Companions who began preparing for Friday prayers on Thursday, thereby linking the verse's imperative to tangible acts of worship and increased reward.
